authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Prakrit *tēla/tella/tilla*, Hindi *tel* and Gujarati/Marathi *tel* continue *taila* ‘oil’. Prakrit tilla also supplies a comparator for Malvi tīl without assigning the sesame-seed noun *tila*. The local form was checked against the Dardic comparanda in the full CDIAL article; no borrowing arrow was applied to this selected comparison.
